description.value: Wang's Shanghai Cuisine is a no-frills Kingsway institution serving handmade Shanghainese dumplings, pan-fried pork buns, and dan dan noodles to a loyal local following. The kitchen turns orders fast and the atmosphere evokes the casual energy of a street-food stall. Cash is the only accepted payment method, so cyclists should come prepared.
